items.title: Murphy USA Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Fuel Contribution
items.summary: MUSA's Q2 earnings surge 53.1% as stronger fuel economics, higher volumes and merchandise gains boost results and raise 2026 earnings power.

items.title: Delek US Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Margins
items.summary: DK posts a major Q2 earnings gain as stronger refining margins and record logistics results drive EBITDA higher.

items.title: Crescent Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y
items.summary: CRGY expects total production guidance of 327-335 MBoe/d, up from 320-335 MBoe/d, and adjusted operating expense guidance of $11-$12 per Boe, down from $11.50-$12.50.

items.title: Marathon Petroleum Q2 Earnings Beat on Strong Refining Margins
items.summary: MPC expects crude oil throughput of 2,820 thousand barrels per day (mbpd) and total refinery throughput of 3,005 mbpd in the third quarter of 2026

items.title: This nuclear startup and Halliburton repurposed oil-drilling tech in a bid to solve America’s radioactive waste problem
items.summary: Deep Isolation is betting on drilling wells to bury nuclear waste if federal regulations evolve.

items.title: TC Energy Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y
items.summary: TRP expects comparable EBITDA at the upper end of its C$11.6-C$11.8 billion guidance and net capital expenditures of C$5.5-C$6 billion.

items.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Halliburton Stock?
items.summary: Halliburton has rallied better than the broader market over the past year, and analysts are fairly bullish about its future growth projections.

items.title: Pembina Pipeline Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: PBA misses Q2 EPS estimates, but revenues rise 20% year over year as higher volumes and operational strength lift results across its business segments.
